full_details: Before church, poor women came to the step. Mistress Ansell gave meal and halfpence by name, and Alse carried the bag. The loaf was short by two fingers and a thumb, at the same penny. At the south porch the dole-table held loaves, grey frieze, and a dish of pence. You put in two shillings of your own and did not speak. She was watching. After sermon you walked to Blackfriars. Jacqueline had a goose, and she told you a man going to court should take a second shirt. Field asked nothing about the second volume. You were home by half past three. The light was going. You wrote the line by candle at four, and you were in bed by eight.
one_sentence: You stood the gooding, put two shillings in the porch box, and ate Jacqueline's goose, where she named a second shirt.
title: Put two shillings in the box and ate the goose
